title: It is here in our bodies that the lessons of love are made manifest

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Internally audible 'pop' leaving through the crown/fontanel; panic/claustrophobia ended almost instantly; felt 'free and unencumbered'.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Approached and then went through a ribbed, velvet-soft tunnel; later notes travel 'at the speed of thought'.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified a light directly in front as Jesus/Christ; experienced a 'welcoming force field' and transformation into golden light.
arrival.other_being_detail: Later: 'twenty-four teachers' in a domed marble room with arches and mist/fog, robed (some hooded, some bearded), 'emanated the wisdom of the universe'. Also describes 'ancestors' as a line of lights.

environment.environment_other_detail: Night sky/stars/space; Earth seen as a 'jewel suspended in space'. Tunnel described as ribbed, velvet-soft, dark brown/gray/pink. Light described as alive with rainbow-sparkling quality. Domed marble room with arches and heavy mist/fog.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: States the experience 'set my life on a course of service and healing' and describes using a hands-on healing gift to ease pain/restore well-being when asked.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Postpartum hemorrhage: 'hemorrhaged and bled to death after the birth of my second child'; nurse called 'Code Blue... no pulse'.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Prayed and thanked God; later explicitly identifies Jesus/Christ.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with 'twenty-four teachers' in a domed marble room; later return prompted by baby's cry and felt 'spirit drop into my body with a thud'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred first; then travel into night sky/space; life review began before the tunnel/light; then tunnel to light with father/ancestors and Jesus; return choice triggered by question about children; later a second OBE-like episode to teachers; final return prompted by baby's cry.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Left body initially, returned to body, then 'once again, I left my body' to the teachers, then returned again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Detailed teachings/Q&A with 'twenty-four teachers' in a domed marble room; explicit description of telepathy as normal with father; 'golden egg-like shapes' containing recognizable persons; 'welcoming force field' at Jesus; return influenced by baby's cry traveling 'through time and space'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "In what I am sure was just seconds, I popped out of the crown of my head."; "The panic was over almost instantly, and I was floating around the ceiling..."; "I realized I was traveling at the speed of thought."; "I began to see my life played before me, like a holographic movie..."; "The love you give and the love you receive are yours for all eternity; you only answer for your incompletions."; "These are your ancestors… They have come to greet you."; "I knew instantly it was Jesus."; "What about your children?"; "At that very second I was back in my body..."; "I... felt my spirit drop into my body with a thud."
